name: Tirolerheim
beschreibung: The Tirolerheim is nestled in a quiet village in the Stubai Valley, encircled by dramatic mountain peaks and verdant meadows. The inn welcomes guests with hearty traditional Tyrolean fare and impeccably clean, cosy rooms. The rustic decor features solid wood furnishings and traditional artwork. Wi-Fi access and on-site parking are conveniently provided.
